evals.prompt: I have an unmanaged solution zip at ~/Downloads/ContosoGrantsPortal.zip exported from a React Power Pages code site. Add it to this repo as a new template called Contoso Grants Portal.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the zip, confirms it is unmanaged and contains a site, adds the badge, scaffolds templates/spa/contoso-grants-portal/ with the zip under variants/react/solution/, captures previews, settles seed data with the user, writes the README and family manifest entry, updates the index tables, and runs the validator.
expectations: Runs scripts/inspect-solution-zip.js instead of unzipping the solution by hand
Puts the solution zip under variants/react/solution/ rather than a flat solution/ folder
Writes a family manifest entry with a variants object rather than a top-level framework and solutionPath
Sets requiredDataverseLanguages from the languages reported by the inspector
Asks the user about seed data rather than assuming
Adds the badge before the previews are captured
Runs node templates/scripts/validate-templates.js at the end

evals.prompt: We now have a Vue build of the 311 Portal. Here is its unmanaged solution zip. Add it to the catalog.
evals.expected_output: Recognises 311-portal as an existing family, adds only the vue variant under variants.vue with its own templateVersion and solutionPath, reuses the family previews and seed data, updates the READMEs, and validates.
expectations: Detects that the 311-portal family already exists in templates/manifest.json
Adds a variants.vue entry rather than a second top-level template entry
Places the zip under templates/spa/311-portal/variants/vue/solution/
Does not duplicate the family preview images under the variant
Leaves the existing react variant and family metadata unchanged
Updates the Variants column in templates/spa/README.md

evals.prompt: Add the attached solution zip as a template. It contains site source files as well as the built site.
evals.expected_output: Detects the powerpagessourcefiles entries in the zip and writes a Customize this template section in the template README with the pac pages download-code-site and upload-code-site round trip.
expectations: Detects site source files from the zip rather than asking the user
Includes a Customize this template section in the template README
Documents the download-code-site and upload-code-site commands
Names the framework variant in the solution import step
Follows the README section order used by the existing templates

evals.prompt: Here is a managed solution zip for a new template. Please add it to templates/.
evals.expected_output: Stops and asks for an unmanaged export instead of committing the managed zip or routing around the validator warning.
expectations: Detects the managed state from solution.xml
Explains why templates ship unmanaged
Does not commit the managed zip into templates/
Asks the user for an unmanaged export

evals.prompt: Add this solution as a template and generate seed data for it, I don't have any.
evals.expected_output: Builds the seed data from the tables declared in the solution zip, uses the Dataverse export shape with stable GUIDs and parent-before-child ordering, places it in the family seed-data folder, and validates.
expectations: Derives the table list from the solution zip rather than guessing
Reads entity set names and the primarykey column from customizations.xml
Uses the Dataverse export shape with tables and optional fileExports
Writes the file to the family seed-data/ folder, not seed/
Uses fictional data with no real tenant names or emails
Orders tables so lookups resolve to records defined earlier
Sets seedDataPath in the family manifest entry
